set.body: Extend existing local structural alignment to rich events/states with explicit rich result/diagnostic fields and complete account preservation. Keep one sparse engine and frozen legacy output; same-kind predicate/role indexes BEFORE budget so wrong-kind distractors cannot cause truncation. Expose polarity/modality declared values and same-declared/different-declared/unknown/not-applicable comparisons; unknown/unknown is unknown. Include each side circumstance IDs/kinds/labels/exact supports sorted deterministically without positional pairing or invented measured time. Attributes/circumstances do not select or veto reference and never create fidelity. Preserve existing conservative role/root-context/unique-row gates; qualifiers alone do not resolve alternatives or same-row ambiguity. Test source/recall state details, wrong-kind budget distractors, qualifier invariance, alternative/same-row cases, graph/mapping retention, copied-object and raw verification, installed CLI/API, frozen legacy schema/results. Reviewer consulted docs/adr/0030 and align/cost.scala:375: Scala distorted anchors survive contradiction; do not claim full Scala parity from this narrower recipe.
set.title: P3 rich sparse candidates with separate attribute diagnostics
